nodes.label: ADR-001: Removal of Hardcoded 17 Oct Cutoff Date
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: removal of hardcoded 17 oct cutoff date
nodes.rationale: Replaced hardcoded 2026-10-17 SQL cutoff with optional user-controlled date range presets (All Time, 30D, 90D, YTD, Custom) to adhere to open-source standards.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Net Amount Column Calculation for Buy Trades
nodes.norm_label: adr-002: net amount column calculation for buy trades
nodes.rationale: Calculates net acquired coins for buys as amount - fee. Returns NULL (dash) for sells because fee is taken from quote currency.

nodes.label: ADR-003: True Net PnL After All Fees and Pool Share
nodes.norm_label: adr-003: true net pnl after all fees and pool share
nodes.rationale: Calculates true net profit/loss by deducting spot buy/sell fees, margin open/close/renewal fees, and Nobitex pool profit share.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Offline TradingView Advanced Charting Library
nodes.norm_label: adr-004: offline tradingview advanced charting library
nodes.rationale: Adopts TradingView Advanced Charting Library v28 bundled 100% locally with offline JS API datafeed instead of lightweight or cloud charts.

nodes.label: ADR-005: TradingView Symbol URL Sync and LocalStorage Isolation
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: tradingview symbol url sync and localstorage isolation
nodes.rationale: Disables save_chart_properties_to_local_storage and sets load_last_chart: false, using onChartReady and Vue watchers to prevent BTCUSDT overwrite.

nodes.label: ADR-006: 1W Timeframe Resolution and Pagination Loop Termination
nodes.norm_label: adr-006: 1w timeframe resolution and pagination loop termination
nodes.rationale: Normalizes resolution W/1W in server and terminates getBars pagination with noData: true when no older historical bars exist.

nodes.label: ADR-007: Widescreen Layout Optimization (max-w-[1920px])
nodes.rationale: Increases main container max-width from 1280px to 1920px and modal width to 1024px to utilize 2K/4K/Ultrawide displays without table cramping.

nodes.label: ADR-008: Bidirectional URL State Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Maintains persistent tab, symbol, timeframe, filter, and date state in URL query parameters using history.replaceState and popstate event.

nodes.label: ADR-009: Open Orders Tab with In-App Cancellation
nodes.norm_label: adr-009: open orders tab with in-app cancellation
nodes.rationale: Provides dedicated spot/margin open orders views with direct in-app cancellation and optimistic UI updates.

nodes.label: ADR-010: Strict Iran Standard Time (UTC+03:30, No DST)
nodes.norm_label: adr-010: strict iran standard time (utc+03:30, no dst)
nodes.rationale: Fixes all time conversions to UTC+03:30 constant offset adhering to Iranian DST abolition law.

nodes.label: ADR-011: BiDi Numerical Isolation and Canvas 2D LTR Override
nodes.norm_label: adr-011: bidi numerical isolation and canvas 2d ltr override
nodes.rationale: Applies .bidi-num CSS class and overrides CanvasRenderingContext2D fillText/measureText direction to ltr preventing reversed text in RTL mode.

nodes.label: ADR-012: Offline-First Architecture and Zero External Telemetry
nodes.norm_label: adr-012: offline-first architecture and zero external telemetry
nodes.rationale: Guarantees 100% offline functionality and zero telemetry by bundling all CSS/JS/fonts locally and storing all data in local SQLite.
